  "control_snapshot_sql": "SELECT p.champion_artifact_id,p.champion_version,p.promotion_reason,p.promotion_evidence_json,\n r.model_name,r.version,r.candidate_type,r.state,r.checksum,r.offline_evidence_json,\n r.training_run_id,r.source_run_date,\n (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',h.event_id,'artifact_id',h.artifact_id,\n   'version',h.version,'effective_at',h.effective_at,'source',h.source,'evidence_grade',h.evidence_grade,\n   'evidence_json',h.evidence_json)) FROM model_champion_history h\n   WHERE h.model_name=p.model_name AND h.retired_at IS NULL) AS history_json,\n (SELECT json_object('artifact_id',m.artifact_id,'cohort_id',m.cohort_id,\n   'payload_checksum',m.payload_checksum,'base_artifact_set_checksum',m.base_artifact_set_checksum)\n  FROM active8_ensemble_pointer_v1 m JOIN active8_ensemble_artifacts_v1 a ON a.artifact_id=m.artifact_id\n  WHERE m.singleton_id=1 AND a.cohort_id=m.cohort_id AND a.payload_checksum=m.payload_checksum\n    AND a.base_artifact_set_checksum=m.base_artifact_set_checksum AND a.validation_decision='PASS'\n    AND a.state='production' AND a.production_effect=1) AS formal_json,\n (__EV_FENCE__) AS current_ev_fence\n FROM model_champion_pointers p LEFT JOIN model_artifact_registry r ON r.artifact_id=p.champion_artifact_id\n WHERE p.model_name='opb_arm_prior'"
